name: Simple Lab - Router Between Two Networks

notes.text: Simple Lab - Router between 2 networks. PC1 192.168.1.10/24 gw 192.168.1.1 (R1 G0/0) | PC2 192.168.2.10/24 gw 192.168.2.1 (R1 G0/1). Test: PC2 ping 192.168.1.10 -> TTL 127 = 1 router hop. Try: remove PC gateway -> ping fails. show ip route on R1 (C + L routes).
